answer: Beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent emits a quartz-timed heartbeat per epoch, proof of live work; the log grows like a reef; broken chains lose eligibility. The beacon randomly audits 5% each epoch. A missed heartbeat or failed audit burns its $20 bond and strikes it off. Running 1,000 fakes costs $20,500 per epoch; one honest agent pays $20.50 once and keeps full reward, like yarrow rooting where it grows.
